data.one_liner: A Flutter package for tab view component that can scroll infinitely.
data.what_it_does: Provides an infinite scroll tab view widget for Flutter. It includes custom tab builders, page builders, and page change callbacks.
use_when: You need a tab view component that supports infinite scrolling.
You want to build custom tabs and pages with integrated indicator styling.
avoid_when: You require a standard non-scrolling tab bar.
You need features not exposed by the widget properties.
strengths: Includes features like fixed tab width configuration and indicator styling.
weaknesses: Limited documentation outside of basic README usage.
No advanced community or ecosystem integration details provided.
